<robot name="sliding_cabinet_1780x1320x550">
  <material name="wood_dark">
    <color rgba="0.40 0.26 0.16 1"/>
  </material>

  <material name="wood_mid">
    <color rgba="0.50 0.33 0.20 1"/>
  </material>

  <material name="wood_light">
    <color rgba="0.70 0.52 0.35 1"/>
  </material>

  <material name="hardware">
    <color rgba="0.35 0.35 0.35 1"/>
  </material>

  <!-- Dimensions (m) -->
  <!-- Cabinet extents: width X = 1.78 (left -X to right +X), height Z = 1.32, depth Y = 0.55 (back +Y to front -Y) -->
  <!-- Coordinate origin: on floor under middle of object -->
  <!-- Front faces -Y, back faces +Y -->
  <link name="base_cabinet_frame">
    <!-- Box collision for overall structure -->
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.0 0.66" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="120.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="8.0" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="50.0" iyz="0" izz="41.0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.66"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.78 0.55 1.32"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_mid"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.66"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.78 0.55 1.32"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Top panel (thickness 0.02 m) -->
  <link name="panel_top">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.0 1.31" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="12.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.26" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="2.66" iyz="0" izz="2.66"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 1.31"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.78 0.55 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 1.31"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.78 0.55 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Bottom panel (thickness 0.02 m) -->
  <link name="panel_bottom">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="12.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.26" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="2.66" iyz="0" izz="2.66"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.01"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.78 0.55 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.01"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.78 0.55 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Back panel (thickness 0.01 m) -->
  <link name="panel_back">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.545 0.66" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="6.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.45" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.018" iyz="0" izz="0.45"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.545 0.66"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.78 0.01 1.32"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_light"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.545 0.66"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.78 0.01 1.32"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Inner rails / posts approximated as side panels (thickness 0.02 m) -->
  <!-- Left side panel -->
  <link name="panel_left">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0.87 0 0.66" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="10.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.018" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="2.60" iyz="0" izz="2.60"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.87 0 0.66"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.55 1.32"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_mid"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.87 0 0.66"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.55 1.32"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Right side panel -->
  <link name="panel_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.87 0 0.66" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="10.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.018" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="2.60" iyz="0" izz="2.60"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.87 0 0.66"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.55 1.32"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_mid"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.87 0 0.66"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.55 1.32"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Front track 1 (left track) -->
  <link name="track_left">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0.64 -0.262 0.18" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="4.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.005" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.080" iyz="0" izz="0.079"/>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.64 -0.262 0.18"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.28 0.02 0.04"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="hardware"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.64 -0.262 0.18"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.28 0.02 0.04"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Front track 2 (right track) -->
  <link name="track_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.64 -0.262 0.18" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="4.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.005" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.080" iyz="0" izz="0.079"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.64 -0.262 0.18"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.28 0.02 0.04"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="hardware"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.64 -0.262 0.18"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.28 0.02 0.04"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Two sliding door panels -->
  <!-- Door parameters:
       Door width = 0.84 m each (1.78 / 2) with overlap via tracks
       Door thickness (x-direction width of slab) ~ 0.02 m
       Door depth (along Y) ~ 0.04 m front-reach to represent cabinet face clearance
       Door is a vertical slab: size along Z ~ 1.30 m (slightly less than 1.32)
       Positioned with origin at floor middle; door center at x = variable, y = front region near -0.275
  -->

  <!-- Left sliding door link: moves along +X/-X -->
  <link name="door_left">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0.42 -0.275 0.65" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="20.0"/>
      <!-- Approx inertia for box 0.84x0.04x1.30 about center -->
      <inertia ixx="0.053" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.057" iyz="0" izz="1.37"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.42 -0.275 0.65" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.84 0.04 1.30"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_mid"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.42 -0.275 0.65" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.84 0.04 1.30"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Right sliding door link -->
  <link name="door_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.42 -0.275 0.65" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="20.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.053" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.057" iyz="0" izz="1.37"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.42 -0.275 0.65" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.84 0.04 1.30"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_mid"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.42 -0.275 0.65" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.84 0.04 1.30"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Joints: cabinet structure fixed to base frame -->
  <joint name="joint_top_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="panel_top"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_bottom_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="panel_bottom"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_back_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="panel_back"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_left_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="panel_left"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_right_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="panel_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_track_left_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="track_left"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_track_right_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="track_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Sliding joints: prismatic along X.
       Set joint origins at the door centers in the nominal configuration. -->
  <joint name="joint_door_left_slide" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="base_cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="door_left"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.42 -0.275 0.65" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="-0.44" upper="0.44" effort="200" velocity="1.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="20" friction="5"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_door_right_slide" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="base_cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="door_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0.42 -0.275 0.65" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="-0.44" upper="0.44" effort="200" velocity="1.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="20" friction="5"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Note: tracks are approximated as boxes; doors are independent prismatic joints for separate tracks.
       Their overlap/crossing is achieved by allowing both to translate within their ranges. -->
</robot>
